mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a robust economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, which leads to higher consumer confidence and increased spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts increase and unemployment rate decreases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production indicates a reduction in supply, which leads to higher prices and lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate and an increase in GDP growth rate indicate a strong economy, but the tightening monetary cycle may reduce borrowing and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when federal funds rate rises and GDP growth rate increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment rate and a low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, which leads to higher consumer confidence and increased spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when employment rate is high and unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a strong demand for goods and services, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales increase and unemployment rate decreases (t-test p > 0.05).
